property.name: sourceObjectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Enter the API name of the object containing the record to display. Example: Call_Cycle__c.

property.name: parentLookupFieldApiName
property.label: Parent Lookup Field
property.description: Optional. On a Record Page, enter the API name of the lookup on the source object that points to the page record. Example: Parent_Cohort__c. Leave blank on Home and App pages to find the current record globally.

property.name: currentRecordFieldApiName
property.label: Checkbox Field That Determines Current Record
property.description: Enter the API name of the Checkbox or Formula (Checkbox) field that identifies which record should be displayed. Exactly one record should evaluate to TRUE.

property.name: fieldSetApiName
property.label: Field Set to Display
property.description: Enter the API name of the Field Set containing the fields to display. Fields appear in the order defined in the Field Set.

property.name: heading
property.label: Heading
property.description: Optional text displayed above the clickable record name. Leave blank to display only the record name.

property.name: iconName
property.label: Icon Name
property.description: Optional Salesforce Lightning icon name. Example: standard:event. Leave blank to display no icon.

property.name: backgroundColor
property.label: Accent Color
property.description: Optional hex color used for the header, outline, and divider. The body is automatically displayed in a lighter shade. Example: #566B50.
